abstract.t: The Universal Modular Protocol (UMP) proposes a modular approach to application-layer communication. Instead of implementing every protocol feature in a monolithic protocol or application, UMP allows communication behavior to be composed from modules that can be obtained from a peer or a repository. A protocol engine manages module execution, communication, signatures, and resource restrictions. Modules execute in a WebAssembly sandbox, while the Protocol Description Language (PDL) is intended to support module composition and analysis. UMP is designed to reduce the effort required to introduce new protocol features, reuse protocol components, and connect applications that otherwise require protocol- specific integration. This document describes the motivation, module model, protocol operation, PDL, repositories, and current implementation status of UMP.
